scientific_integrity: The finite checks are corroborative. The probabilistic conclusion follows from a predictable-sampling Borel–Cantelli argument and the cited confidence-limit theorem. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Almost-sure finite-time graph constancy, not deterministic or integrable stabilization-time bounds; requires finite fixed graph, independent uniformly selected edges, positive confidence increases and subunit confidence decreases. Opinion and confidence convergence invoke established published theorems. No generalization to adaptive edge-sampling weights is asserted.
title: Almost-sure finite-time stabilization of the effective graph in adaptive-confidence Deffuant–Weisbuch dynamics
